metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code skills for various tools and services

plugins.name: shortcut
plugins.description: Work with Shortcut stories, epics, objectives, iterations, docs, labels, and teams - view, search, create, and update

plugins.name: ponder
plugins.description: Build EVM blockchain data indexers using Ponder (ponder.sh) - index smart contract events into queryable databases with type-safe APIs

plugins.name: convergent-review
plugins.description: Review -> fix -> re-review loop until clean, through a code lens, a security lens, or both in the same round. Project-agnostic.

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Try to break a diff: threat-model it, attack each surface, prove attacks with failing tests, fix with regression tests, re-attack the fixes. Project-agnostic.
